message.content: {"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Platform: Infinium HumanHT-12; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Expression profiling was performed on human samples using the Illumina HumanHT-12 microarray platform (RNA expression array)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/description: high-grade soft tissue sarcomas; Experimental Factors: SARCOMA SUBTYPE, TUMOR CELL LINE.","justification":"The study is about soft tissue sarcomas, not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples described as primary high-grade soft tissue sarcomas, two non-neoplastic fat samples and sarcoma cell lines; Organism part: Not found.","justification":"All samples are tumor or fat tissue and cell lines from soft tissue sarcomas—no brain or other CNS tissue is reported."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Additional attributes list 13 representative sarcoma cell lines (e.g., HT1080, MLS1765, MLS402, SW872, FU-DDLS-1, T778, etc.).","justification":"The dataset includes multiple established tumor cell lines (in vitro disease models), meeting the non-clinical/cell-line exclusion criterion. (Also includes primary tumors but cell lines are present.)"},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs: Not found; Experimental Factors describe SARCOMA SUBTYPE, TUMOR CELL LINE, AGE, SEX; no case/control grouping indicated.","justification":"No case versus control study design is described; grouping is by sarcoma subtype and cell line rather than disease vs. healthy controls. Only two non-neoplastic fat samples are mentioned, not a defined control cohort.   "},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"No organism part/brain region entries; samples are soft tissue sarcomas and fat.","justification":"The dataset does not sample any brain regions (so it does not sample brain regions irrelevant or relevant to ALS-FTD)."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Platform: Infinium HumanHT-12; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The assay is microarray-based gene expression profiling (compatible with inclusion criteria), not RNA-seq or proteomics.  "},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: although this is human microarray expression data, the study does not concern ALS-FTD and does not include CNS tissue. It also includes tumor cell lines and lacks a case/control design. Therefore it fails the disease, tissue, and design inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"The experiment uses microarray-based transcription profiling of human RNA (post-mortem brain cortex), so it is human microarray expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title and description: compares RNA from healthy controls and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) patients carrying a C9ORF72 expanded repeat.","justification":"The study explicitly examines ALS cases with the C9ORF72 expansion, which lies on the ALS–FTD genetic spectrum; therefore it pertains to ALS/ALS-FTD."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Sample Source Characteristics: Organism part: motor cortex; Description: post-mortem motor cortex from patients.","justification":"Samples are human post-mortem central nervous system tissue (motor cortex)." },"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Sample Source Characteristics: organism part listed as motor cortex; no cell line/cell type attributes; clinical/familial indicates C9ORF72 ALS (post-mortem).","justification":"Samples are post-mortem brain tissue, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or model systems. (Note: 'In vitro design' appears in experimental design metadata but sample metadata indicate tissue source.)"},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: disease state design; Experimental Factors: disease (normal, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis); Description: comparison between healthy controls and ALS patients.","justification":"The study compares cases (ALS C9ORF72) to healthy controls, i.e., a case/control design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: motor cortex; Description: post-mortem motor cortex from ALS patients.","justification":"Motor cortex is a CNS region affected in ALS and relevant to ALS-FTD neurodegeneration, so the region is relevant."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array.","justification":"The assay is microarray-based RNA expression profiling (compatible); the study does not use RNA-seq or proteomics."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"This is a human microarray transcription profiling study of post-mortem motor cortex comparing ALS (C9ORF72) cases and healthy controls. Samples are CNS tissue relevant to ALS, the design is case/control, and the platform is microarray. There is no indication of in vitro cell lines or incompatible technologies. Therefore it meets the inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Description: analyzed using the Affymetrix Clariom™ D Assay (microarray).","justification":"The assay is an Affymetrix Clariom D microarray and the study is transcription profiling by array on human RNA samples."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description and sample metadata list sporadic frontotemporal lobar degeneration (sFTLD) and familial frontotemporal lobar degeneration (fFTLD, C9ORF72).","justification":"The study concerns FTLD (frontotemporal lobar degeneration / FTD) including C9ORF72-familial cases; FTLD/FTD lies within the ALS-FTD disease spectrum and is directly relevant to FTD-related analyses."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism: Homo sapiens; Organism part: Brodman (1909) area 8; Description: RNA extracted from human frontal cortex area 8 (postmortem).","justification":"Samples are postmortem human frontal cortex (Brodmann area 8), a CNS region."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Sample metadata and description indicate postmortem human brain tissue; no cell lines or in vitro models are reported.","justification":"The dataset uses direct human brain tissue (postmortem) rather than patient-derived cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: controls (n=10), sporadic FTLD-TDP (n=10) and C9ORF72-familial FTLD (n=10); Experimental Design: disease state design; Experimental Factor: disease.","justification":"The cohort includes control and disease groups enabling case/control comparisons."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description states frontal cortex area 8 is “the main area affected in FTLD”; organism part listed as Brodmann area 8.","justification":"Brodmann area 8 (frontal cortex) is a region significantly affected in FTLD/FTD, so it is relevant to ALS-FTD pathology."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Affymetrix Clariom™ D Assay specified.","justification":"The study uses microarray technology (Affymetrix), which is compatible with the inclusion criteria (microarray expression profiling)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"The dataset meets inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of postmortem frontal cortex (Brodmann area 8), includes FTD/FTLD cases (including C9ORF72 familial) and controls in a case/control design, and does not use in vitro models or incompatible technologies. Therefore it is appropriate for inclusion."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

Because the protocol requires confirmed Braak V/VI disease samples, this dataset cannot be confidently included."},"q11_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}
